info.title: brawsr API
info.description: Authenticated browser sessions with explicit checkpoint, rewind, and fork operations plus bounded session workspace reads. Rewind restores browser/client state; it does not undo effects already committed to remote servers.

get.description: Returns a newest-first, cursor-paginated page. Runtime API-key authentication implies the project. Session ID and display_label filters are exact; search is a case-insensitive display-label substring; creation time uses an inclusive lower bound and exclusive upper bound.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the normalized session display label.

patch.description: Strictly updates the optional customer display label. An empty string clears it.

get.description: Upgrade this request to WebSocket with the same bearer credential. After rewind, reconnect to this same URL and discard every object derived from the prior connection.
Returns checkpoints captured by this session, including deletion tombstones. This audit history is not a list of valid rewind targets; use the ancestry collection for that.
Returns only checkpoints reachable from the session's durable head/origin chain. These are the checkpoint IDs eligible for a rewind attempt, subject to their current lifecycle and durability.
Returns lifecycle and operation outcomes without internal retries, worker messages, leases, or saga stages.

get.summary: Get one hop of session fork lineage
get.description: Returns the selected session, its optional parent edge, and one cursor-paged set of direct children. Expand child sessions with another request to render arbitrarily nested forks.

post.summary: Rewind a session to a checkpoint
post.description: Restores browser/client state. Effects already committed to remote servers are not rolled back. Exactly one of checkpoint_id or label is required.

post.summary: Fork a checkpoint into ordered browser sessions
post.description: Creates one to ten independent browser sessions from exactly one checkpoint selector. A completed response contains the entire ordered child set; an accepted response contains only the durable operation and never exposes partial children.

201.description: All fork children are published and usable

WorkspaceLimit.name: limit
WorkspaceLimit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 50.

WorkspaceCursor.name: cursor
WorkspaceCursor.description: Opaque signed cursor returned by the preceding page. It is scoped to the authenticated project, collection, session, filters, and order.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical mutation. Reuse only with the byte-equivalent request.

SessionDisplayLabel.description: Optional customer label after trimming surrounding whitespace. Empty clears the label; control characters are rejected.

cdp_url.description: Present only for an attachable runtime session. It is omitted for closed/expired sessions and human console reads.

Location.description: Relative URL of the exact durable operation resource.
